seo.title: Recursive Trail — Learn. Build. Experiment. Repeat.
seo.description: Two engineers building projects, running experiments, and writing down what we learn. Open for consulting on the side.

hero.headline: Learn. Build. Experiment. Repeat.
hero.subhead: We're a two-person team messing with projects, random experiments, and whatever we want to understand next. We write it down as we go. On the side, we're open for consulting.

services.title: What you'll find here
services.subtitle: Videos, articles, projects, and experiments from the two of us — plus consulting if you need a hand.

items.title: Engineering & Technology
items.description: Notes from work we're actually doing — tools, trade-offs, and the stuff that only shows up once you start building.

items.title: Projects
items.description: Things we built from scratch, including the decisions and the lessons. Not just the finished product.

items.title: Experiments
items.description: Random tools, technologies, and approaches we wanted to try. Some stick. Some don't. Both get written down.

items.title: Learning
items.description: Concepts we figured out along the way — as they clicked, not after we sanded them smooth.

items.title: Problem Solving
items.description: Real problems, mistakes, fixes, and what they taught us. The messy middle stays in the record.

stack.title: Tools we actually use
stack.subtitle: What shows up in our projects and experiments — picked because we ship with it, not because it looks good on a list.

projects.title: Stuff we've built
projects.subtitle: Real projects from the two of us, including the decisions and lessons behind them.

items.name: Personal Context OS
items.description: Capture preferences, routines, and goals, then export them as a portable Markdown pack your AI agents can query over MCP. Local-only for now: speak or type notes in the browser, download a zip, and serve the pack to Cursor or another agent.

link.label: View the repo
link.note: Very early — capture personal context and make it available to AI tools via MCP.

items.name: FitBuddy
items.description: A full-featured, local-first Flutter fitness companion with on-device pose tracking, rep counting, workout and diet plans, progress photos, and optional Gemini form analysis. Includes a React PWA companion and Supabase-backed plan library.

link.label: Join the testing group
link.note: Join to get early builds and help test the app.

why.title: Mostly experiments. Consulting on the side.
why.subtitle: We're two people learning in public — random builds, dead ends, and the bits that actually work. If you need help shipping something, we do that too.

points.title: We build to learn
points.description: Projects and experiments first. The writing follows the work, not a content calendar.

points.title: We write it down
points.description: Videos, articles, and notes from the trail — including what didn't work.

points.title: We take consulting
points.description: Need a two-person team on a product, a problem, or a build? We're open on the side.

process.title: How we actually work
process.subtitle: No methodology deck. This is just the loop we keep running.

steps.title: Learn
steps.description: Something new looks interesting. We go read, poke, and ask dumb questions.

steps.title: Build
steps.description: We turn it into a project or a small experiment instead of stopping at notes.

steps.title: Break
steps.description: We find the edges — what fails, what doesn't scale, what was a bad assumption.

steps.title: Understand
steps.description: We figure out why it worked or didn't. That's the part that actually sticks.

steps.title: Improve
steps.description: We apply it, ship a better version, or drop it and move on.

steps.title: Repeat
steps.description: Then we pick the next thing. The trail doesn't really end.

team.title: The two of us
team.subtitle: Two full-stack engineers. Side projects, experiments, and this trail.

members.name: Abhishek Kumar Singh
members.bio: Turns ideas into shipped products, with work spanning fintech, event platforms, and a steady run of side projects built for the fun of it. Away from the editor, usually travelling, filming, or prototyping the next thing.

members.name: Rakesh Saroj
members.bio: Builds the parts of a product people actually touch — user-friendly interfaces and frontend applications, with an eye for the details that make an app feel effortless to use.

contact.title: Need a hand? We're open for consulting.
contact.subtitle: Most of our time goes into experiments and projects. If you need help with a product, a problem, or a build, tell us a few details and we'll follow up.
contact.successMessage: Thanks — we'll take a look and get back to you shortly.

footer.blurb: Two engineers. Projects, experiments, and consulting on the side.
